Greeks.description: Analytic Black-Scholes-Merton Greeks. Vega/theta/rho are raw derivatives (per 1.0 vol, per year, per 1.0 rate).

theta.description: dV/dT per year (not per calendar day)

OptionPriceRequest.title: EuropeanOptionPriceRequest
OptionPriceRequest.description: Inputs for Black-Scholes-Merton European option fair value. timeToExpiry is a year-fraction.

timeToExpiry.description: Time to expiry T in years (≥ 0)

volatility.description: Annualized volatility σ as a decimal (e.g. 0.2 = 20%)

underlying.description: Underlying S for this quote; may differ by maturity

VolatilitySurfaceRequest.title: ImpliedVolatilitySurfaceRequest
VolatilitySurfaceRequest.description: Shared rate/yield plus market quotes with per-row underlyings.

PaymentRequiredBody.description: Optional JSON body on unpaid requests (server may also return {}). Primary payment terms are in PAYMENT-REQUIRED.

ImpliedVolRequest.title: ImpliedVolRequest
ImpliedVolRequest.description: Solve Black-Scholes implied volatility from a single market premium.

timeToExpiry.description: Time to expiry T in years (≥ 0)

quantity.description: Position size; >0 long, <0 short; must be non-zero

volatility.description: Annualized vol σ for this leg

PortfolioGreeksRequest.title: PortfolioGreeksRequest
PortfolioGreeksRequest.description: Aggregate net Greeks and MTM for a multi-leg European option book.

includeDollarGreeks.description: If true, include cash delta/gamma and per-point vega/theta/rho scalings

timeDecayDays.description: Calendar days of time decay; T reduced by days/365

PortfolioScenarioRequest.title: PortfolioScenarioRequest
PortfolioScenarioRequest.description: Reprice a portfolio under relative spot/vol shocks and calendar time decay.

x-payment.note: Unpaid requests return HTTP 402 with accepts for each configured network. Clients may settle USDC on Solana or Base.
